input.summary: Insert Vendor transition-assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligation into Article XXI (Effect of Termination)
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor materials, with nothing on our own data or exit support, so we added a reciprocal obligation for Licensor to provide up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then delete and certify deletion. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day export right is retained.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee Data (meaning all data, records, trade and order information and other content of Licensee or its customers stored, processed or generated in connection with Licensee's use of the Licensed Technology) in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing.
